scripts.check: npm run check:repo && npm run core:check && npm run web:check
scripts.check:repo: npm run format:check && npm run contracts && npm run docs && npm run generate:check
scripts.core:check: npm run core:lint && npm run core:test
scripts.web:check: npm --prefix web run check && npm --prefix web run test && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json api/**/*.json scripts/**/*.mjs .github/**/*.yml deployments/**/*.yml && npm --prefix web run format && npm run core:format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json api/**/*.json scripts/**/*.mjs .github/**/*.yml deployments/**/*.yml && npm --prefix web run format:check
scripts.generate:check: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- web/src/lib/api/generated.ts
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run core:lint
scripts.test: npm run contracts && npm run docs && npm run generate:check && npm run core:test
